quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Colin Kaepernick's disagreement with Jay-Z's NFL partnership
quotes.excerpt: I disagree with what you're doing. You're selling the culture out to a bunch of racists.
quotes.quote: I disagree with what you're doing. You're selling the culture out to a bunch of racists. At this point, we had done all of the discovery and depositions of the owners of the NFL, so we had all of the insight of the internal conversations as well. He was like, well, the ink's dry. I can't change what you're going to do or what decision you're going to make. Just keep my name out of it. That was my one request, just keep my name out of it.

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Colin Kaepernick on filing a grievance against the NFL
quotes.excerpt: For me, with the NFL blackballing me, my course of action is to file a grievance.
quotes.quote: For me, with the NFL blackballing me, my course of action is to file a grievance, which is essentially litigation against the NFL under that agreement. You go through an arbitration process. As part of that, and these are things that I had to learn along the way, everything is confidential as part of that process from the time you enter it. I thought we would be able to expose all of the documentation and all that. That was not the case.

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Colin Kaepernick on the NFL's collusion against him
quotes.excerpt: At that point, the NFL's actions were irregular, that they were colluding against me.
quotes.quote: At that point, the NFL's actions were irregular, that they were colluding against me. And them denying me a contract, we quantified and tried to recover as part of that. Now what that equates to is losing approximately 150-plus million dollars. But that trying to be positioned in the same light as cutting a deal directly with the NFL to undermine the protests is where that again becomes a nefarious positioning to try to justify the action.
